method: Method: thread lists from Carbonite's Laptops › Apple forum (all threads), plus Resellers and Combo/Full-systems forums (Mac titles only), for threads started from 10 Nov 2020 (the M1 launch) to 23 Nov 2026. The first post and the first page of replies of each thread were read. Regex pre-filled the specs, then an AI read of each ad checked chip, specs, asking price, later price drops by the seller, sold status, condition and damage. Intel Macs, catalogue dumps and non-Mac posts were removed. Damage severity scale: Minor cosmetic (light scratches) < Moderate cosmetic (dents, deep scratches) < Functional – minor (battery service, a dead key or pixel) < Functional – major (cracked screen, display lines, liquid damage, locked) < Non-working / parts. 'Sold' only means the seller said so in the title or replies; a price is the advertised ask, not a confirmed transaction price. Prices are in South African rand.

benchmarks.note: Geekbench 6 averages per Mac model. Each listing is matched on chip, then CPU/GPU core count when the ad states it, then Mac family. When an ad doesn't state cores and the chip came in several configurations, the lowest (base) configuration is used.

privacy: Seller usernames, locations, thread titles and links, and free-text notes are not included.
